stopping: all fixed seeds and windows; any failed assertion fails the campaign
transformation: one actual registry update per cycle changing name role model and cognitive revision; no claim of genome or LLM weight mutation
clone: new registered individual anchored by identity.checkpoints.fork to a parent checkpoint; same initial name role model; no claim of full organism snapshot cloning
learning: runtime decisions.selfModel calibration consumed by identity.modelBoundary; benchmark controller audits when uncertainty exceeds fixed threshold
oracle: BigInt arithmetic versus signed-32-bit fast and decimal school-arithmetic audited executors; disjoint train and evaluation operands and task ids
restart: fresh OS process for each training chunk and feedback-free evaluation window
reuse: same learned domains on new operands after restart; no claim of transfer to unseen domains
statistics: descriptive paired mechanism results; seeds are not independent LLM agents; no population significance claim
